description: cache refresh writes an entry document's context snapshot beside its bound result: entry.kdl sets the layered locale slot (base layer) and the plain region slot, so the state gains the cache entry and one <key>.kdlith-snapshot entry whose header (kdlith-snapshot format=1 canonicalization=1), metadata line (key, entry as spelled, revision, schema fingerprint, profile selection, lineage [entry.kdl], slot count, layout and body digests), and one tagged slot line per slot with its layer are pinned byte for byte; no part file remains
